Enabled.Name: Enable Poker Hand HUD
Enabled.Hint: Enable or disable poker hand HUD for cards

CardSelectionCloseDelay.Name: Card Selection Close Delay (seconds)
CardSelectionCloseDelay.Hint: Number of seconds to wait before closing the card selection dialog after choosing a card

CardSelectionScale.Name: Card Selection Scale Factor
CardSelectionScale.Hint: Scale factor for the selected card in the card selection dialog (1.0 = normal size, 1.5 = 50% larger)

HudCardScale.Name: HUD Card Scale Factor
HudCardScale.Hint: Scale factor for cards in the HUD when clicked with left mouse button (1.0 = normal size, 1.5 = 50% larger)

BookmarkEnabled.Name: Show Bookmark Toggle Button
BookmarkEnabled.Hint: Show/hide the bookmark toggle button for HUD. When disabled, use Ctrl+T hotkey to toggle HUD.

CollapseEnabled.Name: Enable Global Collapse (Local)
CollapseEnabled.Hint: Allow collapsing the entire HUD with a toggle button

SleepHudOnly.Name: On Sleep, Collapse HUD Only
SleepHudOnly.Hint: When collapsed, only affect HUD not cards

HandRetractDelay.Name: Hand Retract Delay (ms)
HandRetractDelay.Hint: Delay before hand retracts when mouse leaves

EnableDisplayOnUse.Name: Display Card on Use
EnableDisplayOnUse.Hint: When a player uses a card from the HUD, automatically display it to all other players with a dramatic reveal.

RemoveCardAfterUse.Name: Return Card to Deck After Use
RemoveCardAfterUse.Hint: Automatically return card to discard pile after sending to chat (uses Foundry VTT pass method)

ReturnToMainDeck.Name: Return Card Directly to Main Deck
ReturnToMainDeck.Hint: Return card directly to main deck instead of discard pile (bypasses discard)

CardBaseImageUrl.Name: Card UI Background URL (World)
CardBaseImageUrl.Hint: Leave empty to use default CSS style.

CardMaskImageUrl.Name: Card Art Mask URL (World)
CardMaskImageUrl.Hint: Provides a shape mask for card art. Leave empty for default gradient effect.

CardBackImageUrl.Name: Custom Card Back URL (World)
CardBackImageUrl.Hint: Leave empty to use default CSS card back.

ClientBackCustomUrl.Name: Custom Card Back URL (Local)
ClientBackCustomUrl.Hint: Leave empty to use world setting. If world setting is also empty, the default CSS card back will be shown.

DisableTilt.Name: Disable Card Tilt (Local)
DisableTilt.Hint: Disable tilt effect when hovering over non-expanded cards. Cards will still lift up but won't tilt.

DisableGradientMask.Name: Disable Card Gradient Mask (Local)
DisableGradientMask.Hint: Disable gradient fade effect on card art. Cards will show full art without bottom fade.

AlwaysShowShadow.Name: Always Show Card Shadow (Local)
AlwaysShowShadow.Hint: Show shadow on cards permanently instead of only on hover. Shadow will be applied to all cards.

EnableUserHandAssignment.Name: Enable User Hand Assignment
EnableUserHandAssignment.Hint: Allow automatic assignment of specific hands to users based on naming conventions

HandAssignmentMode.Name: Hand Assignment Mode
HandAssignmentMode.Hint: How hands are assigned to users

GmHandPrefix.Name: GM Hand Prefix
GmHandPrefix.Hint: Prefix to identify GM-specific hands (e.g., 'GM Hand', 'Master')

DealCardsFaceDown.Name: Deal Cards Face Down to Players
DealCardsFaceDown.Hint: When enabled, cards dealt to players will be shown face down (back side) in the selection dialog

CardBackStyle.Name: Default Card Back Style
CardBackStyle.Hint: Choose which card back to use when cards don't have their own back image

EnableFancyDisplay.Name: Enable Fancy Card Display
EnableFancyDisplay.Hint: Enable enhanced card viewing with 3D animations and effects

DefaultCardBackImage.Name: Default Card Back Image
DefaultCardBackImage.Hint: Default image to use for card backs when none is specified

DefaultCardBorderWidth.Name: Default Card Border Width
DefaultCardBorderWidth.Hint: Default border width for fancy card display

DefaultCardBorderColor.Name: Default Card Border Color
DefaultCardBorderColor.Hint: Default border color for fancy card display

DefaultCardGlowColor.Name: Default Card Glow Color
DefaultCardGlowColor.Hint: Default glow color for fancy card display

EnableDramaticRevealOnDraw.Name: Enable Dramatic Reveal on Draw
EnableDramaticRevealOnDraw.Hint: Show cards face-down then flip them dramatically when drawn

DramaticRevealDelay.Name: Dramatic Reveal Delay (ms)
DramaticRevealDelay.Hint: Delay before dramatic card flip animation begins

WhatDeterminesCardFaceOnDraw.Name: Card Face Logic on Draw
WhatDeterminesCardFaceOnDraw.Hint: How to determine if cards are face-up or face-down when drawn

EnableDisplayOnDraw.Name: Enable Display on Draw
EnableDisplayOnDraw.Hint: Automatically show fancy display when cards are drawn

EnableWhisperCardTextToDM.Name: Whisper Card Text to DM
EnableWhisperCardTextToDM.Hint: Send card details to GM via chat when displayed

PlayersCanShareToAll.Name: Players Can Share to All
PlayersCanShareToAll.Hint: Allow non-GM players to share card displays with everyone

EnableCardIconClick.Name: Enable Card Icon Click
EnableCardIconClick.Hint: Click on card images in decks and chat to view with fancy display
